notes.title: EA Version Beta 0.2.1 Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Since our last EA update, we realized the game lacked completeness. So, we went back to the very beginning – the Prologue chapter – and completely rebuilt it from the ground up. We've now largely completed this overhaul and hope it delivers a significantly better experience for you![/p][p][b]What's New:[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Completely rebuilt the Prologue chapter[/b], adding a massive amount of new storylines and quests. This chapter offers 2-3 hours of gameplay and features two major branching endings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added new Runes, new Skills, and new Equipment.[/b] These powerful spells and gear will help you face more intense battles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Combat & AI.[/b] Enemies are now more strategic in their skill usage and target selection.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded and refined Environmental Interactions & Exploration.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Implemented Character Field of Vision and Hearing systems.[/b] Skill usage is now also affected by line of sight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimized the UI and interaction experience.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Implemented Game Sound Effects and Voice Acting.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved overall game stability and reduced system requirements.[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Important Note:[/b] Due to changes in our development approach, the game's main storyline chapter is currently non-functional. We will [b]temporarily lock this chapter[/b] and focus our efforts on updating its content in the upcoming production phase.[/p][p]Finally, thank you all for your continued support! We hope you enjoy what we've brought this time![/p]

notes.title: Updates for Alpha 0.3.0 Version.
notes.notes:
- Fixes
 • Fixed an issue where the game would crash when enemies entered combat from excessively long distances.
 • Fixed the problem where multiple enemies could not enter combat simultaneously.
 • Addressed several other minor issues.
- Optimizations
 • Adjusted armor-related calculation methods and values to better align combat pacing and skill damage with expectations.
 • Improved map visual performance.
- Known Issues
 • Characters may occasionally become unable to move during gameplay. In  most cases, this can be resolved by clicking the "Return to Camp" button  or saving and reloading the game.

notes.title: Alpha0.3.0 Update（4.4.2025）
notes.notes:
Dear players, we’re thrilled to announce the English localization update!  Alongside this, we’ve added new systems and expanded the game map to  include dark and treacherous underground areas. Here are the key  highlights of this update:
- New Additions
 ・Added English localization for game interfaces, skill descriptions, and quest details.
 ・Implemented a Character Traits System for all characters. Players can now customize their characters through unique trait combinations during creation.
 ・Introduced a foundational Social Relationship System. NPCs will react to player attacks based on their friendship levels.
 ・Expanded the map with underground cavern areas, teeming with dangerous monsters.
 ・Added new equipment and equipped every weapon with a unique combat skill. Certain gear now grants special effects.
- Fixes
 ・Fixed an issue where item statuses occasionally failed to save correctly.
- Optimizations
 ・Improved overall game stability.
 ・Upgraded graphic effects in select scenes.
 ・Adjusted numerical values for better balance.
 ・Refined skill animations and performance.
Thank you for your support! If you’d like to share feedback or discuss the game, please leave your thoughts on our Steam Community page. We’re listening!
